meta.title: Jean-Félicien Gacha Foundation — Bangoulap, Cameroon
meta.description: A social, cultural and humanitarian NGO in Bangoulap, West Cameroon: education, vocational training, crafts, culture, health, environment and community tourism.

footer.tagline: We must help others, listen to others, respect others… and above all, love others.
footer.about: A social, cultural and humanitarian NGO founded by Ly Dumas in Bangoulap, in memory of her father Jean-Félicien Gacha.
footer.newsletterSuccess: Thank you! You are now subscribed.

home.intro: From Bangoulap, in the highlands of West Cameroon, the Jean-Félicien Gacha Foundation nurtures vocations, develops talent and shares knowledge.
